weather_line: Clearing on the eastern ridge · Mrs. Holt reports seven more ducks ready

stories.headline: Standing Committee Identifies Its First Matter; Matter Is a Puddle; Puddle Predates the Committee by Forty Years
body: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters convened its third session Thursday morning and, after ninety minutes of deliberation, identified the first substantive issue it intends to address: a persistent puddle at the eastern end of Diagon Alley, approximately four feet in diameter, origin unknown, which has occupied the same coordinates since at least 1983.

The puddle, sources confirm, is not on any map the Committee currently possesses. This is considered promising. A working group — the Subgroup on Standing Water and Comparable Phenomena — has been constituted and asked to report back by the end of September, at which point the Committee will determine whether the puddle falls under 'Broadly Geographic' or 'Adjacent Matters.' The two camps are already forming.
Tibbs, invited in a non-voting capacity, has still not replied. The puddle has not been consulted.

stories.headline: Thursday's Queue Raises an Unusual Point of Order; Christine Raises a Better One; the Queue Moves On
body: A mid-morning account-holder arrived at Gringotts Thursday with a question that, by his own description, was 'technically more of a philosophical observation about the nature of compound interest.' Christine listened for forty-five seconds, identified the underlying vault issue, resolved it, and had him signing the amended ledger before the philosophical portion of his sentence was complete.

Griphook the Younger, now in what colleagues privately describe as 'a period of visible professional admiration,' filed Thursday's reports three minutes early. He has been observed, once, holding the door again. No one has mentioned it.

stories.headline: Steve Walks the Spur with Mrs. Holt; Spur Fully Mapped; Jeep Waits at the Trailhead with What Witnesses Describe as Dignity
body: Friday's planned walk has been quietly moved to Thursday by mutual agreement — Mrs. Holt, it emerges, rises at five and considers mid-morning 'the late afternoon.' Steve met her at the ridge access point at half past six. The spur, previously resistant to all mapping efforts, revealed itself to Mrs. Holt's direction with no apparent difficulty. She pointed; Steve walked; the Jeep waited below, its fourth duck catching the early light.

Mrs. Holt confirmed she has seven additional ducks at home, each with a hat already attached, earmarked for 'vehicles that look like they've done something.' The Jeep, upon Steve's return, was noted to be idling with slightly more composure than usual. The Jeep did not comment, but the Jeep was clearly pleased.

stories.headline: Jersey Formally Petitions for Lap Rights During All Future Committee Proceedings; Petition Filed in the Warm Spot by the Window
body: Jersey, Gentleman of Leisure and household's foremost authority on warmth distribution, has this week lodged what can only be described as a territorial claim over the armchair nearest the afternoon sun. The claim was filed silently, at approximately two o'clock, by the method of sitting in it and becoming very heavy.

No formal challenge has been mounted. Lucy has assessed the situation and declined to contest it on grounds she has not disclosed. Ellie attempted to sit in the chair, found Jersey already there, and appeared to conclude that the chair had always contained Jersey and she simply hadn't noticed before.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has reviewed the Mrs. Holt matter, noted that she identified the correct conclusion on day one, and returned to her regular schedule without fanfare. The thread jar remains on the kitchen table. Lucy has not asked for it to be moved.
Ellie: Spent a portion of Thursday morning greeting her reflection in the kettle, which she has decided is a different dog entirely and one she finds very agreeable. The kettle had no comment.
Jersey: Secured the armchair at 2:04 p.m. by weight alone. Has since been asleep. Is still asleep. The armchair does not appear to mind.
founding_editor_note: That puddle's been there since '83 because nobody fitted a proper drain. I could have fixed it in an afternoon. Still could, if someone would hand me a trowel and overlook the portrait situation. — D.

in_brief.sport: Thursday Standings: Christine, 1; philosophical observations about compound interest, 0.
in_brief.forecast: Mild and unhurried through the evening; the armchair warm, the spur mapped, the puddle unresolved and perfectly content.

storyline_updates.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: The Committee has identified its first substantive matter — a forty-year-old puddle at the eastern end of Diagon Alley, unmapped and unclaimed. The Subgroup on Standing Water and Comparable Phenomena has been constituted. Internal division forming between the 'Broadly Geographic' and 'Adjacent Matters' factions. Tibbs still has not replied to his non-voting invitation. Day 3 should bring the Committee closer to Christine's territory — perhaps the puddle is found to lie near a Gringotts access point, or a passing reference to vault-adjacent drainage is made in the working group's preliminary notes, putting Christine on mild, amused alert.
